environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate (1 vCPU, 2GB RAM) behind an NLB (Layer 4). No request timeout configured at the load balancer level. The service IAM role has dynamodb:PutItem and dynamodb:Query on the user-content table with no condition keys. No input length limits enforced at the API Gateway or middleware level. Node.js 18 single-threaded event loop processes all requests sequentially per container.
